name: Kuro Mahou Shoujo Sadistic Youko
original_name: 黒魔法少女サディスティック妖子
source:
Yuko is a weak girl with black-magic study as a hobby. One day a transfer student protects her from a bully. Yuko falls in love with the boy and summons a demon to insult all the girls that seek transfer student attention. Main character is that devil who preys for these girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
优子是一个以研究黑魔法为爱好的软弱女孩。有一天，一名转学生保护她免受欺凌。优子爱上了这个男孩，并召唤恶魔来侮辱所有寻求转校生关注的女孩。主角就是那个捕食这些女孩的恶魔。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
